polygon.style: stroke-width: 0.00; stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; fill: #0072B2; fill-opacity: 0.15;

g.text: Exact posterior density (a change of variables from the posterior of sigma_tau). Solid line:
posterior mean; dashed line: the value at the posterior mean of sigma_tau^2; shaded: 95% posterior
interval. The density grows without bound near I = 0; its vertical axis is cut there. The gray line
at 1/2 is where the second-order term of the mean reliability minus I changes sign (Lee, 2026).
Posterior summaries, conditional on the supplied standard errors.
